loadout_known_id.note: Index is discovery only. Standard is unit-level; issue/custody stays in state.

command_capacity.note: Load commander plus direct reporting leaf units/subordinate command nodes. One shared personnel/slot budget regardless of ownership.

unit_partition.note: Split/merge conserves people, capability lineage, injuries, equipment and history. Partial durable standard change requires split.

unit_refit.note: Load target unit, exact loadout record, inventory/issue owners. Target standard does not instantly issue gear.

mass_battle.note: Load real participating units and compact battle kernels first; wake full capability only on material asymmetry/close thresholds.

units.note: Known unit_id -> load the unit routing index, derive base before first dot, then load only that tiny group shard and exact unit. Do not glob state/unit.

unit_capability.note: Full multidimensional aggregate distribution, authoritative and cold.

unit_kernel.note: Derived broad-battle fast path; source hash must match full capability.

home_establishment.note: Resolve owner_id to one establishment shard only.

institutional_role_slot.note: Load the known institution's role-slot registry only when an unmaterialized office, vacancy, succession, appointment continuity or officeholder materialization is causally relevant. Role slots are institutional continuity, not hidden characters.

formation.note: Templates are reusable data. Active formation exists only inside a mapped mission/operation/state owner when instantiated and owns no manpower.

unit_development.note: Load unit + training profile + capability refs only as needed; rebuild kernel after authoritative capability changes.

equipment.note: Known loadout ID uses direct path template in loadout_known_id; index only for discovery.

formation_deployment.note: Only after an active operation/battle has instantiated real units/command nodes.

units_by_owner.note: Only when enumerating all units of one known force owner. Owner-specific unit index is derived/non-authoritative.

command_group.note: Command-only node, owns no manpower. Parent counts one slot; descendants load on subordinate.

command_tree.note: Load root commander, only directly referenced units/people/groups, recurse only as far as needed. Do not load unrelated armies.
